sources.gpw_v4_popdens_*: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University. Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPW v4): Population Density, Revision 11. NASA SEDAC, 2018. https://doi.org/10.7927/H49C6VHW. CC BY 4.0. Cut into 30-degree tiles; values unchanged.
sources.GDP*: Wang, T. and Sun, F. (2022). Global gridded GDP data set consistent with the shared socioeconomic pathways. Scientific Data 9, 221. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01300-x; data: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.16741048. CC BY 4.0. 0.25-degree files, historical (GDP{year}.tif) and SSP1-5 (GDP{year}_ssp{n}.tif); values unchanged.
